question.question: After removing a ruin last item, what happens to its building slot, and can ordinary building placement remove a ruin instead?

expected.expected_answer: Remove ruin and slot becomes open. Ordinary placement cannot remove ruin; ruins removable only explicitly, and building needs open slot.

source_passages.section: Actions — Shared movement, crafting and battle; clearing slots and ruins
source_passages.quotation: Clearings have fox, rabbit or mouse suit and limited building slots. Buildings require open slots; tokens do not occupy these. Ruins block their slots and can be removed only when explicitly allowed. A forest is enclosed by printed paths and clearings; it is adjacent to clearings touching it without crossing a printed path and to forests separated by just one printed path. Winter's river also divides forests.
- **Explore:** Exhaust torch in ruin's clearing. Take one hidden item face up into Satchel or track; score one VP if an item taken. Remove ruin when its last item is taken, freeing the building slot.

answer.ruling: When the ruin's last item is taken, remove the ruin and free its building slot.
No. Ruins block their slots and can be removed only when explicitly allowed; ordinary building placement does not itself remove a ruin.
